title: OpenAI's Two New Models Are 4x Apart on Price
description:
OpenAI launched GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. Per OpenAI, Astra costs $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Sol costs $2 and $10. That is four times apart, both ways. Astra is for the hardest projects: documents, slides, code, even 3D design. Sol is for everyday work. OpenAI says Astra more than doubled Claude Fable 5.2's pass rate at about one-sixth the cost on a benchmark it cites. We haven't tested that claim.
